projects.name: UTokyo Digital Archives Project
projects.entity: The University of Tokyo, Committee on Archives of Academic Assets
roles: Member, Office for the Digitization of Academic Assets
projects.description: Technical lead of the project from its design stage (talk on the planned archive system, 2018-02). Designed and built the archive platform (Omeka-based collections, IIIF, TEI, LOD) and the cross-departmental UTokyo Digital Archive Portal. Worked on data preservation (2021) and presented the project at more than ten meetings from 2018 to 2021. Continues to operate the platform and portal as a member of the team.

Online exhibition *Kunshūjō*
UTokyo Digital Archive Portal (about 280,000 items across departmental archives)

projects.name: Toyo Bunko research databases
projects.entity: Toyo Bunko, Research Group for Comprehensive Asian Area Studies
projects.description: Built the group's research databases and the IIIF image repository, working with Toyo Bunko researchers on the Buddhist canon and map materials. projects.name: Cultural Japan
projects.entity: Cultural Japan team (direction by Akihiko Takano, National Institute of Informatics; with the NPO Rensō Shuppan)
roles: Developer (Search System, IIIF Viewers, IIIF Discovery)
projects.description: Developed the search system, the IIIF viewers and IIIF Discovery, as listed on the team page. Now runs the whole service, including operation and maintenance, except for the RDF store. As of 2026-11, Cultural Japan holds 2,778,052 records from 204 databases, including Japan Search and overseas museums such as the British Museum and the Art Institute of Chicago.

projects.name: Digital Tale of Genji
projects.entity: Volunteer initiative of researchers and University of Tokyo Library staff (the "Ura-Genji" study group)
roles: Developer; principal investigator of JSPS KAKENHI 19K20626
projects.description: Developer of the system and first author of its papers. Built the text-research platform with IIIF and TEI, and the AI image search that compares manuscripts and printed editions using kuzushiji OCR and edit distance. Worked with Takashi Tamura, Kiyonori Nagasaki and the University of Tokyo Library staff study group ("Ura-Genji").
highlights: Digital Tale of Genji
Kōi Genji Monogatari Text Database (TEI/XML, LOD, DTS, IIIF)
Digital Tale of Genji: AI image search
OdGenji — Olfactory Database for *The Tale of Genji*
